errors.network: The server cannot be reached. Check that Tolarix is running.
errors.notFound: This item does not exist. It may have been deleted.
errors.tooManyAttempts: Too many wrong passwords. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.csrf: Your session expired. Reload the page and try again.
errors.notHere: This run was started from the command line and can only be stopped there.
errors.nameTaken: This name is already used. Choose another one.
errors.inUse: This is still used by a flow.

auth.signInBody: Enter the admin password of this Tolarix server.
auth.forgotHint: Forgot it? Run "tolarix admin reset-password" on the server (in Docker: docker exec -it <container> /tolarix admin reset-password).
auth.choosePasswordBody: You signed in with a one-time password. Choose your own password to continue.
auth.unreachableBody: Tolarix is not answering. Check that it is running, then try again.

password.hint: At least {{min}} characters. A short sentence is easy to remember and hard to guess.
password.same: Choose a password different from the current one.
password.mismatch: The two passwords do not match.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.intro: Your sync flows and how their last run went.
dashboard.emptyBody: A flow copies pages from one Master wiki to one or more Mirror wikis. Start by adding a connection to each wiki.
dashboard.stepConnections: Add a connection to each wiki

connections.title: Connections
connections.intro: A connection tells Tolarix how to reach one wiki: Azure DevOps, Confluence or an Obsidian vault.
connections.newIntro: Choose the type of wiki, then tell Tolarix where it is. You can test the settings before saving.
connections.empty: No connections yet. Add one for each wiki you want to sync.
connections.kindFixed: the type of a saved connection cannot change.
connections.nameHint: A name you will recognise, for example "Team wiki".
connections.secretHint: Stored encrypted on the server and never shown again.
connections.secretStored: A secret is stored. It is never shown.
connections.secretWillBeRemoved: The stored secret will be removed when you save.
connections.deleteBody: Tolarix forgets this connection and its secret. The wiki itself is not changed.
connections.deleteInUse: It is used by {{flows}}. Remove it from those flows or delete them first.

connectorKinds.obsidian: A folder of Markdown files (an Obsidian vault) on this server.
connectorKinds.azure-devops-code: A wiki published from a Git repository in Azure DevOps (Services or Server). Tolarix reads and pushes commits through the REST API.
connectorKinds.confluence-dc: A Confluence Data Center or Server space, or a page and everything below it.
connectorKinds.azure-devops-project: The project wiki of an Azure DevOps project (Services or Server). Tolarix reads and pushes commits to its hidden Git repository through the REST API.
connectorKinds.confluence-cloud: A Confluence Cloud space (atlassian.net), or a page and everything below it.

obsidian.pathHint: The folder on the server that contains the vault, for example /vaults/team. In Docker it must be a mounted volume.

location.folderHint: Mirrored pages go into this folder. Leave it empty to use the top of the vault.

azure-devops-code.urlHint: Open the wiki in Azure DevOps and copy the address from the browser (…/_wiki/wikis/<name>), or the repository folder it is published from (…/_git/<repo>?path=/docs).
azure-devops-code.tokenHint: Create it in Azure DevOps under User settings → Personal access tokens, with the Code (Read & write) scope.

location.folderHint: Mirrored pages go into this folder, for example Mirrors/Team. Leave it empty to use the top of the wiki. Each run is pushed as one commit.

confluence-dc.urlHint: Open the space (or the page to start from) in Confluence and copy the address from the browser.
confluence-dc.tokenHint: A personal access token (Profile → Personal Access Tokens). With a username, this is that user's password instead.
confluence-dc.usernameHint: Only for password sign-in. Leave it empty when you use a personal access token.

location.parentHint: Title (or numeric id) of the page that mirrored pages go under. Leave it empty to use the connection's page, or the top of the space.

azure-devops-project.urlHint: Open the project wiki in Azure DevOps and copy the address from the browser (…/<project>/_wiki).
azure-devops-project.tokenHint: Create it in Azure DevOps under User settings → Personal access tokens, with the Code (Read & write) scope.

location.folderHint: Mirrored pages go into this folder, for example Mirrors/Team. Leave it empty to use the top of the wiki. Each run is pushed as one commit.

confluence-cloud.urlHint: Open the space (or the page to start from) in Confluence and copy the address from the browser, for example https://your-site.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/DOC/overview.
confluence-cloud.emailHint: The email of the Atlassian account the API token belongs to.
confluence-cloud.tokenHint: Create a classic API token at id.atlassian.com → Security → API tokens. Scoped tokens are not supported yet.

location.parentHint: Title (or numeric id) of the page that mirrored pages go under. Leave it empty to use the connection's page, or the space homepage.

flows.title: Flows
flows.intro: A flow mirrors a Master wiki, or part of it, into one or more Mirror wikis.
flows.dryRunHint: Shows what would change without changing anything.
flows.busyHint: Wait for the run to finish.
flows.deleteBody: The flow and its run history are deleted. Pages already copied to the Mirrors stay where they are.

flowWizard.intro: Choose what to copy, where to copy it and how.
flowWizard.masterHint: The wiki where people write. Tolarix only reads it.
flowWizard.masterFixed: The Master of a saved flow cannot change. Create a new flow to mirror another wiki.
flowWizard.enabledHint: A disabled flow can still be run by hand.

scope.allHint: Every page. Untick pages below to leave them out.
scope.selectedHint: Tick the pages or folders to mirror; everything below them is included.

flowWizard.scopeRequired: Tick at least one page or folder.
flowWizard.emptyMaster: The Master wiki has no pages yet.
flowWizard.mirrorsHint: Mirrors receive a copy of the Master. Pages that Tolarix creates there are overwritten on every run.
flowWizard.mirrorIsMaster: A Mirror cannot be the Master wiki itself.
flowWizard.mirrorDuplicate: This is the same as Mirror {{n}}.
flowWizard.deletePolicy: When a page is removed from the Master

policy.archiveHint: The page is moved to an archive area, so nothing is lost. Recommended.
policy.deleteHint: The page is deleted from the Mirrors too.
policy.keepHint: The page stays on the Mirrors and is no longer updated.

flowWizard.attachmentsHint: Images and files used by the pages.
flowWizard.banner: Add a notice to mirrored pages
flowWizard.bannerHint: A short note at the top of every copied page tells readers to edit the Master instead.
flowWizard.bannerTextHint: Leave it empty for the default text. "{master}" becomes the name of the Master.
flowWizard.bannerDefault: This page is mirrored from {{master}}. Changes made here will be overwritten.
flowWizard.adoptHint: When a Mirror already has a page exactly where a copied page goes, Tolarix updates it instead of stopping with a conflict.
flowWizard.created: Flow "{{name}}" created. Try a dry-run to see what it will do.

runs.title: Runs
runs.intro: Every run and dry-run, newest first.
runs.dryRunNote: This was a dry-run: it shows what would change. Nothing was changed.
runs.reportPending: The report is ready when the run ends. Follow the log meanwhile.
runs.logTruncated: Only the last 5,000 lines are shown.

logState.error: The live log is not available.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appearanceHint: Theme and language are in the top bar and are remembered by this browser.
settings.changePasswordHint: Other browsers signed in as admin are signed out.

kind.manual: Only when I run it manually

schedule.dayHint: Months without this day are skipped.
schedule.exprHint: Five fields: minute, hour, day of month, month, weekday (e.g. 0 7 * * 1-5), or @daily, @weekly, @monthly. Times are in the timezone below.
schedule.timezoneHint: Schedule times are in this timezone. Default: the server's ({{tz}}).
schedule.builtInHint: Turn it off to start this flow from your own cron with "tolarix run-due" instead.
schedule.manualPreview: It runs only when you start it, with Run now or "tolarix run …".
schedule.disabledNote: The flow is disabled, so it does not run by itself.
